layout.resizing: all panels within a tab are user-resizable via drag handles (react-resizable-panels or equivalent)

StockPicker.purpose: AI chat generates Python code that screens/selects candidate stocks

components.name: AIChatPanel
components.description: Chat with OpenAI to describe a picking strategy in plain language

components.name: CodePreviewPanel
components.description: Shows the AI-generated Python code before/after running, read-only with syntax highlighting

components.name: RunControls
components.description: Run / Stop / Re-run buttons for executing generated code in sandbox

components.name: ResultsTable
components.description: List of selected stocks with key columns (symbol, price, matched criteria, timestamp)

components.name: StrategyVersionSelector
components.description: Dropdown/list to view or switch between saved versions (v1, v2, v3...) of the current strategy

components.name: SaveStrategyButton
components.description: Persist current code+results as a new/updated Strategy version

components.name: SavedStrategiesSidebar
components.description: Browse previously saved strategies from this or other tabs

StockAnalyzer.purpose: Deep-dive visualization of the subset of stocks picked in StockPicker

components.name: AIChatPanel
components.description: Ask the AI to analyze/explain patterns in the selected stocks

components.name: StockListPanel
components.description: The subset of stocks carried over from StockPicker, selectable one at a time or multi-select

components.name: CandlestickChart
components.description: OHLC chart for the selected stock with overlay indicators

components.name: IndicatorControls
components.description: Toggle indicators: moving averages, RSI, MACD, volume, Bollinger Bands, etc.

components.name: MetricsPanel
components.description: Key value/fundamental metrics for the selected stock (P/E, market cap, etc. if available)

components.name: ComparisonView
components.description: Side-by-side or overlay comparison across multiple selected stocks

components.name: NotesPanel
components.description: Freeform notes/annotations per stock, saved to workspace store

Backtesting.purpose: Run a Strategy + RiskProfile against historical data

components.name: AIChatPanel
components.description: Describe risk logic in plain language to generate/edit a RiskProfile; also used to adjust backtest config

components.name: StrategySelector
components.description: Pick a saved Strategy (with version) to backtest

components.name: RiskProfileSelector
components.description: Pick a saved RiskProfile (with version) to attach, or create a new one via chat

components.name: BacktestConfigPanel
components.description: Date range, capital, instrument universe, other run parameters

components.name: RunControls
components.description: Run / Stop backtest execution

components.name: TradeLogTable
components.description: Trade-by-trade log: entry/exit date, price, qty, P&L, signal reason

components.name: SummaryStatsPanel
components.description: Win rate, total return, avg win/loss, max drawdown, Sharpe ratio, trade count

components.name: EquityCurveChart
components.description: Cumulative P&L over time

components.name: RunHistoryList
components.description: Past backtest runs for this strategy, for comparison

components.name: PromoteToLiveButton
components.description: Explicit action to promote this Strategy+RiskProfile combo to the Live tab group

LiveStockPick.purpose: Pick stocks against live market data, manually or via a promoted strategy

components.name: AIChatPanel
components.description: AI assistance for manual picking or adjusting a live strategy run

components.name: ModeToggle
components.description: Switch between Manual and Strategy-based picking

components.name: PromotedStrategySelector
components.description: Choose which promoted strategy is actively screening (Strategy mode only)

components.name: LiveWatchlistTable
components.description: Live-updating (WebSocket) table of tracked/matched stocks with price, volume, signal status

components.name: ManualSearchBar
components.description: Search/add any instrument manually to the watchlist

components.name: SignalFeed
components.description: Real-time stream of new matches/signals as they fire

LiveTrade.purpose: Order execution — manual or bot-based, with approval gating

components.name: AIChatPanel
components.description: AI assistance/explanation for pending trade suggestions

components.name: ModeToggle
components.description: Switch between Manual and Bot-based trading

components.name: PendingApprovalsQueue
components.description: Bot-proposed trades awaiting user approve/reject (default mode)

components.name: AutonomousModeControls
components.description: Per-strategy opt-in toggle for autonomous execution, only enabled after backtest+trial requirements met

components.name: OrderTicketPanel
components.description: Manual order entry: instrument, qty, order type, price, SL/target

components.name: PositionsTable
components.description: Live-updating (WebSocket) open positions with P&L

components.name: OrderBookTable
components.description: Pending/executed/cancelled orders for the day

components.name: RiskControlsPanel
components.description: Max position size, daily loss limit, max trades/day, kill switch

components.name: LivePnLSummary
components.description: Realized + unrealized P&L for the day

openQuestions: Concrete default values for RiskControlsPanel limits
